camera.name: live-camera
camera.intrinsics_notes: fy fitted from 10 live samples (pinhole: mean d*h/1.3m, person height 1.3 m); fx=cx=cy assumed. NOT chessboard-calibrated.

depth.reason: depth backend disabled (pass --enable-depth; requires torch + transformers)

result.note: Empirical only. Negative r suggests higher confidence coincides with lower error on this dataset; it is NOT a calibrated probability.

notes: Real-image evaluation. Synthetic data from Task 2 is never mixed in.
